_evidence: Overlay for 0x00406d4b and its scans 0x406b6c (forward) / 0x406c6d (backward) (compose after ring_00406ac7+ring_0040aec5+state_004067ea: lap records 0..7, pit start 9..10, pit end 12..14, so every scanned record is 0..14). Byte 0x627948 selects the scan ('cmp byte,0; je'): zero or not, half each. Each scan runs word [0x868558] + 2 passes ('movzx ecx; add ecx,2 ... dec ecx; jne', each pass an 0x4067ea fpatan classification and possibly 0x4067b7): any u16 is valid (at most 65537 bounded passes), but the per-run instruction budget caps it at a 0..40 record search (the image value 0 only ever ran 2 passes; callers use it as the lap word, cf. state_0040bce6's 0..256). 0x4067b7 -> 0x4065c3/0x4066be read the record's dwords +0x118/+0x11c/+0x120/+0x124 (subtracted from the reference position 0x6278c0/0x6278c8, imul/shrd 14) and its angle words +0x12c/+0x12e (masked cosine-table index: 'shr 2; and 0xfffe' keeps it inside 0x7c5c5c..0x7c9c5a): plain arithmetic, any value, for records 0..15.
